history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V16 workload, scored mode, job count, checksum, timing boundary, engine-availability ruling, acceptance decision, attribution metric, external-suite boundary, and unavailable metric. It changes no scored row. It re-pins only the exact-parent integration after its frontend counters and fail-closed collection guards changed. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric source, adapter, integration ruling, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Re-freezes the completed efficiency/thermal panel after exact-parent collection gained frontend compiler counters plus fail-closed competing-job, transient-overlap, and contaminated-build rejection. Every scored workload and result contract remains inherited unchanged.

contract_changes: frontend compiler counters are retained with every sample
competing long-running jobs reject collection before sampling
transient overlap rejects the affected exact pair
exact_parent_integration.publication_boundary: Only an explicitly selected quiet-reference host on AC power may support an efficiency claim. Required counters must be measured and stable at at most 5% RSD, every thermal observation must remain nominal, generated-code/cache claims additionally require their exact category metric, and every raw sample remains visible. Diagnostic hosts never gate or support a public ratio. Collection also fails closed before or during sampling when competing work or contaminated build feedback invalidates the exact-parent comparison.
